content.what_it_is: MATLAB utility script in FUNWAVE-TVD test_bathy converting a GeoTIFF DEM to FUNWAVE depth text files. Reads 'myfile.tif' via Tiff class (name @L5, name1 @L6, t=Tiff(name1,'r') @L7, data=read(t) @L8); negates and vertically flips elevation to depth dep=-flipud(data) @L10; previews with pcolor(-dep),shading flat @L12; crops dep1=dep(1:100,1:72) @L13 and writes it row-wise with format %6.2f to 'dep_72x100.txt' (@L14-19); then smooths with a 3x3 kernel K=0.11111*ones(3) @L25 via conv2(dep1,K,'same') @L26, replacing only interior points excluding edge=5 border cells (@L23, @L28); converts to double @L30 and saves ASCII 'filtered.txt' @L32. Commented lines @L2-3 show a previous uiopen-based load of 'ncei_nintharcsec_dem_J1043928.tif'.
entities: script (no functions); variables: name @L5, name1 @L6, t @L7, data @L8, dep @L10, dep1 @L13, fid @L14, i (loop) @L15, edge @L23, K @L25, tmp @L26, dep2 @L30

verbatim_spans.text: edge=5; % set edge points you dont want filter

unresolved: K=0.11111*ones(3) sums to 0.99999, not exactly 1 (1/9=0.1111...) — slight energy loss per filter pass; whether intentional shorthand unresolved

crop dep1=dep(1:100,1:72) @L13 (100 rows x 72 cols) vs output filename 'dep_72x100.txt' @L14 — name orders 72x100; FUNWAVE reads row-per-line, so rows=100 lines of 72 values; naming convention (Mglob x Nglob) implied but not stated in file

filtered output 'filtered.txt' is written from dep1 after in-place interior replacement @L28 but the unfiltered 'dep_72x100.txt' was already written @L14-19 — which file downstream cases use is not determinable here
name='myfile' placeholder @L5 requires manual edit; commented NCEI ninth-arcsecond DEM reference @L2-3 indicates original data source
